executionArgs.additionalInstruction: This is a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend served via `npx serve` on port 5173. The backend API runs on http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1. The app uses localStorage for auth (auth_token, auth_role). Login page is at /index.html. Admin dashboard at /admin.html requires role=admin. Viewer dashboard at /viewer.html requires role=viewer. Test auth flow, CRUD operations, search, and role-based access control.
